description: CohortStudio tutorial study configuration: plausibility rules (the family clinical_anomalies, named Implausible values in the application) and inclusion criteria for assets/tutorial/tutorial_cohort.csv. Load it on Data > Validate (sidebar: Load Existing Config) or with the tutorial cohort from the Start page.

Implausible age.description: Ages below 0 or above 110 years are data-entry errors.

Height not in centimetres.description: Adult heights below 100 cm were typed in metres (1.72 instead of 172).

Implausible weight.description: Adult weights of 20 kg or less, or above 300 kg.

Diastolic above systolic.description: Diastolic pressure cannot reach the systolic pressure: the two fields were swapped.

lvef_pct.description: Numeric rule on the column lvef_pct: values outside 5-85% are flagged.

potassium_mmol_l.description: Numeric rule on the column potassium_mmol_l: values outside 2.5-7.0 mmol/L are flagged (haemolysis or typing errors).

Last contact before enrolment.description: The last contact must follow enrolment (dates are day-first, dd/mm/yyyy).

Written consent.description: Patients without written informed consent are not analysed.

age.description: Numeric rule on the column age: adults aged 18 to 85 are included.

Symptomatic heart failure (NYHA II-IV).description: NYHA class I (no symptoms) is not eligible.

No severe kidney disease.description: Creatinine above 265 umol/L (about 3 mg/dL) excludes the patient.
